phát triển năng lực phân tích, tư vấn và: Develop capacity to analyze, consult and resolve legal issues in business activities, investment, trade and competition in the context of integration.
sẵn sàng cho bước học tiếp theo?: Ready for the next step in learning?
trao đổi về chương trình, nền tảng đã họ: Discuss the program, your academic background and your goals with us to prepare for your next step.
hiểu sâu pháp luật. giải quyết vấn đề tr: Deep understanding of the law. Solve problems in business.
chương trình thạc sĩ luật kinh tế tại vă: The Master of Economic Law program at Van Lang is designed with an the applied track, helping students master in-depth knowledge of business law and develop skills in analysis, consulting, negotiation, litigation and handling legal issues that arise in practice.
khối kiến thức tập trung vào pháp luật d: The knowledge block focuses on corporate law, investment, trade, land and competition; at the same time, expanding to labor, tax, real estate, economic crimes, legal risk control and practice topics.
thông qua thực tập và đề án tốt nghiệp,: Through internships and capstone projects, students apply knowledge in the context of agencies, organizations and businesses, improve the ability to draw professional conclusions and propose appropriate legal solutions.
văn bằng tốt nghiệp: thạc sĩ luật kinh t: Degree awarded: Master of Laws in Economic Law.
kiến thức pháp luật được tổ chức quanh n: Legal knowledge is organized around practical issues of business, investment, trade, competition and risk management.
các chuyên đề thực hành rèn kỹ năng nhận: Practical topics to practice skills in dispute identification, mock arbitration, drafting, negotiating and signing commercial contracts.
người học có thể mở rộng chuyên môn sang: Students can expand their expertise to labor, tax, real estate, economic crimes, administrative sanctions and legal risk control.
thực tập 8 tín chỉ và đề án tốt nghiệp 9: The 8-credit internship and the 9-credit capstone project create space to apply knowledge to a specific legal issue in practice.
chương trình thạc sĩ luật kinh tế được c: The Master of Economic Law program was recognized as meeting educational quality standards according to regulations of the Ministry of Education and Training in November 2025, strengthening the foundation of the program, team and quality assurance activities.
bảy chuẩn đầu ra bao quát kiến thức pháp: Seven learning outcomes covering legal knowledge, professional skills, digital competencies, foreign languages and professional responsibilities.
tổng hợp nguyên lý triết học, nền tảng k: Synthesize philosophical principles, legal science foundations and research methods to solve legal problems in Economic Law.
đề xuất giải pháp phù hợp cho các vấn đề: Propose appropriate solutions for issues arising in corporate, investment, trade and competition law.
phối hợp kỹ năng lựa chọn và áp dụng quy: Apply skills in selecting and interpreting legal provisions, drafting, advising, negotiation, legal research and litigation.
phối hợp kỹ năng làm việc độc lập, làm v: Combine skills of independent work, teamwork, communication, presentation, logic, creativity and legal thinking.
tích hợp nền tảng số, công cụ ai và năng: Integrate digital platforms, AI tools and foreign language skills into learning, research and professional practice.
tuân thủ pháp luật, quy tắc đạo đức nghề: Comply with the law, rules of professional ethics and regulations and discipline of the University, agencies and units.
chủ động cập nhật kiến thức, thích ứng v: Proactively update knowledge, adapt to changes in economic law and draw expert conclusions.
chương trình phù hợp với ai?: Who is the program suitable for?
từ nền tảng pháp luật đến chuyên môn luậ: From legal background to economic law expertise.
ứng viên cần tốt nghiệp hoặc đủ điều kiệ: Applicants must hold or be eligible to receive, a bachelor's degree or higher in an appropriate field and meet the foreign language entry requirements under the admissions regulations.
luật; luật hiến pháp và luật hành chính;: Law; Constitutional and Administrative Law; Civil Law and Civil Procedure; Criminal Law and Criminal Procedure; Economic Law; International Law; International Trade Law; Criminology and Crime Prevention; Theory and History of the State and Law. No bridging courses are required.
bao gồm các nhóm về khoa học giáo dục, đ: Includes groups on educational science, teacher training, legal English, economics, politics, management, communications, business, finance, accounting, administration, logistics, urban management, healthcare, services and some related security and legal industries. Compare transcripts; study a maximum of 19 bridging study credits.
01 nhóm ngành luật luật; luật hiến pháp:
01 Law Disciplines
Law; Constitutional and Administrative Law; Civil Law and Civil Procedure; Criminal Law and Criminal Procedure; Economic Law; International Law; International Trade Law; Criminology and Crime Prevention; Theory and History of the State and Law. No bridging courses are required.
02 Other Eligible Fields
Includes education sciences, teacher education, legal English, economics, politics, management, communication, business, finance, accounting, administration, logistics, urban management, healthcare, services and certain related security and legal disciplines. Transcripts are reviewed; up to 19 bridging credits may be required.
đáp ứng yêu cầu tương đương bậc 3 trở lê: Meet the requirement equivalent to Level 3 or above under Vietnam's six-level foreign language proficiency framework, or provide equivalent evidence recognized in the admissions announcement.
học phần thực tế cần bổ sung được xác đị: The specific bridging courses are determined from qualifications, transcripts and previous coursework.

vững chuyên môn pháp lý. mở rộng vai trò: Strong legal expertise. Expanding career roles.
người học có thể phát triển theo hướng h: Students can develop in the direction of legal practice, corporate law, state management, research and training.
công việc liên quan đến quản lý kinh tế,: Work related to economic management, international integration, courts, procuracy and management agencies at the Central and local levels.
luật sư, tư vấn tại công ty hoặc văn phò: Work as a lawyer or legal consultant in a law firm, or as an in-house legal specialist in a business.
làm việc tại các tổ chức liên chính phủ,: Work at intergovernmental, non-governmental organizations or international organizations that need legal and economic expertise.
giảng dạy, nghiên cứu tại trường đại học: Teaching and researching at universities, research institutes, and training centers; continue studying to the PhD level as prescribed.
chương trình gồm 10 tín chỉ kiến thức ch: The program includes 10 credits of general studies, 33 credits of basic and specialist knowledge, and 17 credits of internship and capstone project.
học sâu luật kinh tế. vận dụng vào thực: Deepen Your Knowledge of Economic Law. Apply It in Practice.
